messages:
Priya (Product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands. Folks asked for concrete ship windows for API surface updates, Console per-route analytics, and Optimize feature toggles. I'll summarize and we can confirm owners.
Diego (Eng): API surface: non-breaking aliases go out May 15; breaking SDK restructure ships as a major on May 29. We will support old helpers for one month via compat layer with deprecation warnings.
Lena (Eng-ML): Optimize rollout: feature-gated recommendations UI (opt-in) -> June 7. Automated suggestion engine + policy hooks -> late July (target July 26). We'll gate auto-rollouts behind the eval suite.
Nina (DevRel): Can we get a small diff for the SDK so we can craft migration notes? We need a short snippet for docs and the quickstart.
Diego (Eng): Sure. Snippet: 
```js
// before
const r = await Redwood.generate({ model: 'rwd-3-mini' })
// after
const r = await Redwood.text.generate({ model: 'rwd-3-mini' })
```
We'll push a migration doc May 22.
Priya (Product): Console analytics tiers: alpha for internal teams = June 14, external beta with per-route breakdowns = July 12, GA = Sept 8. Beta will include token heatmaps and rollout annotations.
Ravi (CEO): Heads-up: Dedicated customers should get early beta access for Console since they have SLAs. Make sure legal has the invite list signed off.
Nina (DevRel): I'll prepare the invite template and short blurb for customers. Target to send invites May 31.
Diego (Eng): Test plan for Optimize autoscale: synthetic bursts w/ and w/o KV cache June 21-25. Need to validate p95 latency and fallback behavior.
Lena (Eng-ML): Quality gate: if top-level evals show >2% decrease in relevance (ROUGE/BLEU hybrid) we pause automated enablement. Manual rollout still possible per-customer.
Priya (Product): Are these dates firm or flexible? A few customers asked if GA could be earlier.
Ravi (CEO): We prioritize reliability. Timelines are targets, but we can accelerate narrow customer rollouts if risk is manageable. Public GA stays as planned unless betas look rock-solid.
Diego (Eng): Action items: 1) Migration guide by May 22 (me). 2) Console alpha checklist by June 1 (Lena + Product). 3) Run autoscale tests June 21-25 (me). I'll post results in #eng-runtime.
Lena (Eng-ML): I'll own the evaluation harness and the regression report. Expect first pass June 10.
Nina (DevRel): I'll own comms and the beta invites. Will drop a draft in #product-updates tomorrow.
Priya (Product): Please put a short follow-up doc in the product repo with the bullets and dates; I'll pin it to the all-hands channel.
ci-bot: build:console-analytics-alpha passed (build 5034) :white_check_mark:
Diego (Eng): Nice. That CI run is the alpha baseline. We'll run a larger trace set tomorrow.
Nina (DevRel): I'll prepare the public-facing changelog blurb once migration guide lands.
Ravi (CEO): Thanks team. Priya, book a 15-min sync next week if anything slips.
Priya (Product): Will do. I'll post the follow-up doc in ~24 hours and tag owners. Thanks everyone!
